name: Simulated census tract SES index for the OHDSI GIS benchmark
description: SIMULATED composite socioeconomic status index (0-100, higher = more affluent) for US census tracts (2010 vintage), generated by the benchmark data generator: the county SES index plus a tract deviation correlated with the tract's PM2.5 deviation from its county mean, so that SES confounds the PM2.5 effect within counties too. It is not a real tract statistic. The index is static over 2014-2019 and is attached to the census tract polygons loaded from TIGER/Line 2019.

about.name: Generation of the simulated tract SES index
about.description: County SES plus a tract deviation, drawn deterministically per tract GEOID by the benchmark generator (syntheticDataGIS/tract).

variableMeasured.name: geoid
variableMeasured.description: Census tract identifier: state + county + tract FIPS, eleven numeric characters

variableMeasured.name: ses_index
variableMeasured.description: Simulated composite socioeconomic status index, 0-100, higher = more affluent. Static over 2014-2019.
